about: WoW Forever's release phases, in release order. The client already carries content the game has not opened yet; what a phase lists (and everything only it gives: loot, quests, recipes) shows as Later instead of missing until the phase opens. opens: the date it opens (YYYY-MM-DD), or null while Blizzard has not announced one. maps: instances by English name or map id. npcs, objects, quests, items: ids (npcs also by English name). See docs/PHASES.md.
